answer:
The name of the star of **"Forced Vengeance"** is **Chuck Norris**.

There appears to be some confusion in your question. "Forced Vengeance" was not part of the television show - it was actually a standalone action film released in 1982 starring Chuck Norris. 

Chuck Norris is also the star of the TV show you mentioned (though it's called "**Walker**, Texas Ranger," not "Walter"). He played the title character Cordell Walker in that series from 1993-2001.

So Chuck Norris is the common star connecting both works - he appeared in "Forced Vengeance" (1982) and later starred in "Walker, Texas Ranger" (1993-2001).
